name: BTC and ETH relative-value reversion v1
signal: Each fourth hour, use the last observable hourly open (one full hour lag). Compare log(ETH/BTC) with mean and sample standard deviation from the preceding 672 hourly observations. Enter opposite directions when absolute z reaches 2. Each leg capped at 40% of equity, round down to venue quantity step. No adding to positions.
exit: Exit on the first hourly observation with signed z <= 0.25, signed z >= 3.5, or 168 hours elapsed, or at evaluation end. No same-hour re-entry.
costs: Simulated adverse fills 0.10% per side plus taker fees 0.06% per side on both legs. Receive or pay actual funding on each signed position at settlement before the next fill. Reserve 10% of gross current marked exposure for collateral.
benchmark: Idle USDT. Forward eligibility requires net profit in both chronological phases and no collateral or data failure. Compare to 2% weekly on whole equity including idle hours.
